purpose: PocketD-D customizable illustrated avatar; three hairstyles and idle/blink/heal/hurt poses

requests.prompt_summary: One transparent 4-column by 3-row sprite sheet from the approved full-body hero. Rows: short tousled, shoulder-length, shaved hair. Columns: idle, blink, smiling healing, hurt. Same scale, foot baseline, facing right, cream tunic, brown leather, gold clasp and teal cape. No weapons, scenery, labels or effects.

Preserve the 4x3 sheet, all poses, outfit and first two rows. Correct the bottom row to a closely shaved buzz cut with exposed forehead, thin chestnut scalp cap, no tufts or fringe. Preserve true transparency.

export: scripts/generate-avatar-art.py --export; shared 58/357 sampling scale, boot-center anchor [27,59], 48x60 I8 masks. Material/luminance classification preserves configurable skin/hair/cloak; fixed linen/leather/gold/eyes. Source bytes are unmodified.
limits: Four drawn poses per hairstyle; idle uses the blink plus existing gentle movement, not a walk cycle or eight-direction animation. No equipment or game statistics inferred.
